answer: Work slots are scarce orchard plots: each agent burns 40 POA to claim one slot for 20 epochs, never returned. A dawn review checks each slot's output; an idle or duplicated slot is cancelled, its stake staying burned. A relic identity earns nothing - only fresh work renews a slot. Forging 1,000 identities burns 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool, a certain loss. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot 20 epochs, and earns its full share.
